data.text: Education extends far beyond textbooks. We offer a rich spectrum of experiential learning, field excursions, and cultural events.

items.title: Educational Excursions
items.description: Visits to the National Science Centre, Nehru Planetarium, National Museum of Natural History, and Sultanpur National Park.

items.title: Corporate Office Visits
items.description: Guided 2-3 hour exposure visits to leading corporate offices, inspiring students about modern career opportunities.

items.title: Cultural Celebrations
items.description: Grand celebrations for Independence Day, Republic Day, Diwali, Christmas, Teacher's Day, and Earth Day.
